subject: Post-call: buying journey snapshot + champion enablement
messages:
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0700
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>, Karen Liu <karen.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Subject: Post-call: buying journey snapshot + champion enablement

Hi Samir and Karen — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all stay aligned.

TL;DR:
- Champion: Samir is the internal champion and daily owner for the POC/technical validation.
- Economic owner: Karen will lead the final commercial sign-off (total cost + SLA).
- Security + procurement will run parallel checks (timeline below).

Key decision criteria (as discussed):
1) Response latency under 200ms p50 for templated prompts (short responses).
2) Clear data isolation and retention controls (ability to keep logs for 90 days, point-in-time deletes).
3) Predictable unit costs at scale (forecast for ~200M tokens/month).
4) Onboarding support during POC (dedicated SE time + playbook).

Stakeholder map (rough):
- Samir Patel — Champion / Eng lead (owner of POC)
- Karen Liu — VP Product (Economic buyer)
- Acme Security (sec-team@acme.com) — Security review and data handling
- Procurement (procurement@acme.com) — Contract & purchase order

Proposed next steps with owners: 
- Samir: Share a short test-data spec + initial prompts by Wed 11/4. (Samir)
- Security: We will kick off the security questionnaire; I'll send the SOC2 + data flow diagram by EOD. (Tessa)
- Procurement: Rishi to prepare a preliminary commercial term sheet and non-binding price estimate by Fri 11/6. (Rishi)
- Internal enablement: Vanessa and Priyom will get a one-pager and internal talking points to Samir for stakeholder outreach. (Vanessa/Priyom)

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (high level), acme-map-stakeholders.xlsx (blank template to fill), initial-sow-draft.docx (POC scope).

Questions / asks for Samir and Karen:
- Can Samir confirm the POC target workload (approx tokens/day and typical prompt sizes)?
- Karen, can you confirm the internal procurement timing (target month for PO) and whether there are any specific invoicing requirements?

Thanks — I'll follow up with the security packet and the HubSpot deal link.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Strategist
Redwood Inference

--

Thanks Tessa — this is super helpful. Quick answers inline: 
- POC workload: aiming for 10k reqs/day initially, average prompt ~120 tokens, expected burst patterns during business hours.
- Test data: I'll redact PII and share a 2-hour sampling of our prompts by end of day Wednesday.
- Security: Can you include the default retention settings and whether we can toggle retention per-project? Acme policy requires ability to delete data on demand.

Also looping in our security alias — sec-team@acme.com — they may have a couple of technical questions about network egress and key management.

Will fill the stakeholder spreadsheet and tag any other internal champions.

—Samir
Engineering Lead, Conversational AI
Acme Corp
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0700
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: sec-team@acme.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>, Karen Liu <karen.liu@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Post-call: buying journey snapshot + champion enablement (security packet)

Hi Acme security team — thanks for joining the thread. Attached are the items you requested during the call: SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, and our privacy FAQ. Highlights you asked about: 

- Retention: Default logs retained 30 days; configurable per-customer to 0/30/90/365 days. We support on-demand data deletion via API and console with audit logs.
- KMS/HSM: We integrate with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/GCP KMS) and can support key rotation policies you require.
- Network model: For Private deployments we support VPC peering and non-routable private connectivity; hosted options use egress via our managed infra with documented IP ranges.

If helpful, Rishi can coordinate a short 30m security deep-dive with our infra security lead later this week. Proposed slots in HubSpot linked here: https://app.hubspot.com/schedules/12345/redwood-security

Regards,
Tessa

--

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Subject: Internal: commercial framing + short talk tracks for Samir/Karen

Team — prepping the price sketch and a short enablement packet for Samir/Karen. Draft notes below (we'll turn into a one-pager):

Commercial framing (non-binding):
- POC (60 days): subsidized POC — up to 5M inference tokens covered; additional usage billed at $0.0009/token.
- Post-POC pilot (3 months): forecasted at 50M tokens/month; list price $0.0007/token with volume tiers and commitment discounts.
- Dedicated & SLA add-on: if they require 99.95% uptime and a dedicated pool, estimate +35% on unit cost.

ROI talk tracks for Samir to use with Karen / Eng leadership:
1) Cost: show sample modeled token spend vs current self-hosted infra (GPU amortization) — typical customers see 20-40% lower unit cost after optimizing batching + KV caching.
2) Time-to-value: Redwood handles model ops, upgrades, and fallbacks so Samir's team spends weeks not months to production.
3) Risk mitigation: our fallback routing and version pinning prevents regression during model pushes.

Security/compliance bullets for procurement/security review (one-liners for Samir):
- We provide SOC2 Type II report and support customer-managed KMS.
- Logs and deletion APIs with audit trails.
- Private deployment option when required for data residency or air-gap.

Tasks: Vanessa — assemble a 1-pager + sample slide with the cost model. Priyom — draft the short email talk track and a one-slide ROI chart. Tessa — can you attach the SOC2 packet to the HubSpot deal and send to Samir?

Rishi
Director, Commercial Ops
